description: Get a provider's aggregate earnings and payout history: what has been earned, what has already been paid out, and what is pending. Use when someone supplying GPUs asks how much they have made, when they were last paid, or why a figure differs from what they expected — earned is not the same as paid, and this separates them. Read-only and free, and it moves no money: requesting a payout is a separate action.
